title: Airfried Mediterranean Chicken
description: A flavorful, healthy meal that's easy to make. Chicken is marinated in Mediterranean spices and cooked to perfection in an air fryer.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken breasts to the marinade and mix to coat. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it in the air fryer basket. Cook for 12-15 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is cooking, mix the tagine spice mix with a little water to create a paste.
After the chicken is cooked, brush the tagine spice paste onto the chicken breasts.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
